_comment: Units that exist without a purchase in any tradebook: a corporate action
created them, or they predate the export window. Copy this file to
opening-lots.json (gitignored) and add your own. Each lot seeds the FIFO queue
before the tape is replayed, so a later sell has a cost basis to match against.
Every entry is a claim about history that no export can prove, so say where

why: Example demerger: the parent's cost basis was apportioned between the two
resulting stocks, using the ratio your broker publishes.
